move: finger taps heart: squash, fill wipes up, burst ring and confetti, counter ticks, un-like
how: A square frame with a soft radial glow, a heart SVG (dark outline over a pink fill masked by a clipPath rect), a thick ring, 18 coloured particle dots, a pointing-hand cursor and a '1,204 likes' label with the number in a clipped roller. The glow breathes scale .9->1.05 yoyo over the whole loop (sine.inOut). 0-18%: the hand slides in from the lower right (expo.out), moves onto the heart, and at 30% presses (scale .85, power2.in) then releases with back.out(3). On release at 34%: the heart, squashed to .8, springs to 1.28 with back.out(4) then settles to 1 with elastic.out(1,.4); the clip rect y 100->0 wipes the pink fill up (power3.out, 0.32s); the outline turns pink; the ring scales .3->1.9 while its border thins 26->2px and fades (expo.out); the particles fly out radially (r 260-400px, expo.out) then drop and fade; the count slides out (yPercent -100), swaps to '1,205' and slides in with back.out(2). At 85% everything reverses: fill wipes down, outline darkens, heart does a small .9 dip, count rolls back to '1,204', so the last frame matches the first.
adapt: Change the count strings, the pink (#ff3b6b) and particle colours, the heart path for any reaction icon, and the background glow. Keep the press/release beat (.12s + back.out(3)), the back.out(4) overshoot and the 0.32s fill wipe.
port: mount(el, shot) builds the heart SVG with a uniquely-id'd clipPath, the particles and the label inside el; animate(el, shot, D) returns the timeline with positions as fractions of D (press 0.3D, burst 0.34D, un-like 0.85D). The fx.rng seed for particle angles stays in mount; scope '#hcr', '#cnt' and all selectors to el and rename ids to avoid collisions; particle radii 260-400px assume a 1080 stage.
caveats: the ring fromTo uses immediateRender:false already; the cursor from() needs it when nested
clipPath id must be unique per instance
ends on the same idle state as frame 0
